name: Orange Botswana Francistown Disaster Recovery Site
notes: Orange Botswana's 2018 data-centre migration program described a third project to build a full disaster recovery site in Francistown. Francistown is treated here as the North East coverage area because the batch omits a separate Francistown city division.

name: Mascom Maun Data Centre
notes: Botswana Daily News reported Mascom investment including a data centre in Maun. Public technical details and capacity were not found.

name: Digital Delta Data Centre
notes: BoFiNet's Digital Delta facility in Gaborone is a national, Tier III-design carrier-neutral data centre with about 1,000 square metres and 400 racks; DCD reported the launch in December 2025.

name: BTC Sentlhaga Data Centre
notes: BTC markets data-centre solutions from Sentlhaga Data Centre in Gaborone; DataCenterMap lists 120 square metres of white space. No credible public MW capacity figure was found.

name: Orange Botswana Innovation Hub Data Centre
notes: Orange Botswana opened a P150 million data centre at Botswana Innovation Hub in Gaborone, reported as the first of three migration-program sites.

name: Mascom Innovation Centre DC1
notes: Uptime Institute lists Mascom Innovation Centre DC1 in Gaborone as a Tier III Design-certified facility. Public evidence reviewed did not confirm live operations or a reliable MW capacity.

name: Nashua NEST Data Centre
notes: Aggregator listings identify Nashua NEST at Nashua House in Gaborone as a colocation/data-centre facility. No primary source, build date, or MW capacity was found.
